original_source_items.meaning: J7 physically routes distinct Ethernet, USB, DisplayPort, SATA and TIA232 channels; not an operating logical network service.
J7 WR_EN/WR_EN_RTN electrical short enables nonvolatile memory writing; original Rule spelling varies between WR_EN_RTN and WR-EN_RTN.
J8 RF connector provides 19 individually labeled 50-ohm antenna channels up to 50GHz; no measured signals or observed equipment.
J9 RF connector has eight separately labeled 50-ohm antenna channels up to 22GHz and distinct BMB mating specifications.
J8 VSWR limits vary by four frequency bands; J9 has one DC–22GHz bound; values are design criteria, not measured link quality.
Auxiliary coaxial connectors have source-specific TNC/SMA/2.4mm/1.0mm ranges and application-dependent quantities, not mandatory sensor frequencies.
Original J7 table refers to ANSI/VITA76.0 and a Meritec part or equivalent; vendor equivalence not independently tested.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Network-visible participant
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J7 provides physical Ethernet and serial interfaces.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No separately identified or reachable network participant or actual IP endpoint.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Network instance and connection context
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J7 has source-native physical pair, shield and protocol pins.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No live connected network session, negotiated address or service.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Physical constituent
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J8/J9 are two distinct conditional RF connector arrangements.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Neither establishes installed components, mandatory containment or a general DIM chassis.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Composition member exposure and source attribution
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J8 may join physical sensor elements through RF contacts.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No individually represented CSAPI member or attributed digital report.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported output field
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J8/J9 Ch1–Ch19 or Ch1–Ch8 are physical pin/channel designations.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not 27 digital observation fields or physical sensor instances.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared component capability catalogue
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J7 declares specific hardware transport/protocol design support.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No verified runtime-advertised service or connected source-case hardware.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared command interface
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Physical maintenance switch enables nonvolatile writing.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not a software Command endpoint, authorization scheme or request schema.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Issued control request
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Hardwired contact closure is a physical maintenance provision.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No executed CSAPI command transaction or request identity.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Command acknowledgement / reported outcome
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Electrical write-enable closure prescribes hardware behavior.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No reported success, acknowledgement or observed memory write.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component capability and readiness report
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Interface designs constrain potentially supported physical signals.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not current operational readiness or present-device capability report.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component property-value report
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: VSWR maximum-by-band is a design/test criterion.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not a transmitted or observed instantaneous RF property value.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Required and recommended capability support
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J8/J9/auxiliary RF connector rules have scoped conditions, not universal application.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No compulsory interfaces for all sensing Systems or adopted CSAPI Profile SHALL.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Negotiated message encoding and model version
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Physical USB/DisplayPort protocol specifications carry edition references.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No negotiated model schema, OGC content-type or software version contract.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported physical parent/child attachment relationships
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: RF connections can physically interconnect sensor elements.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No established installed attachment of named individual assets.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported component receive data rate
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: A 10GBase-T Ethernet channel is specified at design level.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not measured current received data rate or online link.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported component transmit data rate
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: A 10GBase-T Ethernet channel is specified at design level.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not measured current transmit throughput.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported received signal power
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: VSWR maxima constrain impedance mismatch by frequency.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not received radio-frequency signal power in dBm.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — reporting path
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Pinout and RF connector families provide physical signaling options.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No observed data path to a CSAPI service or sensor reporting endpoint.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — control execution
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Write Enable depends on physical contact closure.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No authorizable software action, execution evidence or effect.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Link Loss value — reference question
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: VSWR is an RF impedance mismatch criterion.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not definition or resolution of ISA-Q002 Link Loss concept.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Signal Strength Ratio — reference quantity question
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Voltage standing wave ratio is specifically defined for mated RF contacts.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not established as ISA signal-strength ratio concept ISA-Q004.

exact_holds.description: Original J7 pinout figure 13.5.2.8-1 has not been verified at full image/contact geometry; Table source rows are text-read.
Original J8 pinout and SMPM size12 mating diagrams 13.5.2.9-1/-2 were not independently verified visually.
Original J9 pinout and BMB size8 mating diagrams 13.5.2.11-1/-2 were not independently verified visually.
Original dense modality checkbox placement in J7/J8/J9/auxiliary RF tables remains unverified; text pins and frequency bounds were inspected.
Original ANSI/VITA76.0 full source, Meritec-equivalent connector compliance and shell-plating measurements were not examined.
J7 Table 13.5.2.8-1 contains an unnumbered same-shell-plating SHALL distinct from the 27 numbered Rules; preserve exact native standing.
J7 table refers to USB3.0/2.0 while numbered Rule13.5.2.8.2-1 requires USB3.1 G2; do not silently harmonize scope or versions.
Original IEEE802.3an-2006, USB3.1/2.0, DisplayPort1.3, SATA3.0 and TIA232 native specifications were not read.
J7 WR_EN_RTN versus WR-EN_RTN spelling differs in original Rule13.5.2.8.6-2; preserve source text without inventing a second pin.
J7 maintenance Write Enable is a physical hardware closure, not a network-issued CSAPI software Command or verified equipment action.
J8 original SAE AS39029/56, MIL-DTL38999 and MIL-STD348B Change3 connector originals remain unexamined.
J9 original SAE AS39029/59, MIL-DTL38999 and MIL-STD348B Change3 connector originals remain unexamined.
J8 frequency-banded VSWR limits 1.25:1/1.30:1/1.40:1/1.60:1 are design criteria; no actual mated pairs were tested.
J9 1.40:1 DC–22GHz VSWR limit is original design criterion, not a measured link-quality or RF power reading.
J8 up-to-50GHz and J9 up-to-22GHz described antenna-channel families do not establish operational frequencies or device signal quality.
Auxiliary TNC/SMA/2.4mm/1.0mm RF interfaces have application-specific quantities; there is no universal required quantity or actual installed connector.
The original C239 DSDM, IDL and six OpenAPI companion bytes, later 2025 S251 and restricted Appendix C remain unexamined.
None of the four empirical source cases establishes installation or conformance of these J7/J8/J9 RF source-specific connectors.
No mandatory DIM chassis/class/cardinality, CSAPI Profile SHALL, real device command or independent runtime conformance was adopted.
